name: Special Topics in Information and Communication Technologies for Development and Sustainability
description: Special topic that focuses on state of the art and research problems of importance in this area. This can include but may not be limited to topics such as data science for development and sustainability, deployment of computer networks and software systems, human computer interaction, scaling challenges in ICTD initiatives, policy topics, and others.
